note: Assists tab of the command list. Keyed by AssistName (data/assist_list.tres), then by the assist move's MoveName (5S / 6S). Every key is optional: name and desc default to the move's DisplayName and Description in assist_list.tres, the input to S / 6 S / 4 S from its Direction, the preview to its StateIndex. states = the assist's state indices played one after another in the preview. "*" = rows every assist shows (preview: {"state": "Assist Call"} plays the shown fighter's call pose).

extra.name: Calling in Neutral
extra.desc: Free on the ground, but your fighter poses and can't block while the assist comes in. Not in the air or while blocking.

extra.name: Assist Cancel
extra.desc: During a normal or special that hit or was blocked, the assist comes at once with no pose. Not out of an EX move, super or throw.
